LEVERAGED_ORDER_TYPEHASH.details: Unified EIP-712 typehash for all leverage order actions (open, close, swap).      The `action` field (LeverageAction enum, encoded as uint8) discriminates intent.      Used for both direct-signing (full EIP-712 digest) and session datahash (raw struct hash).

devdoc.title: LeverageRfqEngine

broadcastOrder((uint8,address,address,ad.notice: PreSign an order and broadcast it on-chain. The engine computes the digest.

cancelOrder((uint8,address,address,addre.notice: Cancel a specific order by marking its digest as filled.         Only the order's user (order.user == msg.sender) may cancel.

cancelOrderWithSession((uint8,address,ad.notice: Cancel an order on behalf of a session owner (delegate-initiated).

closeLeverage((uint8,address,address,add.notice: Fill a signed RFQ order to close (decrease leverage on) a position.

closeLeverageFlash((uint8,address,addres.notice: Flash-style close: withdraw collateral first, then execute a callback that must deliver         `buyToken` to this engine so it can repay the user's debt and optionally deposit leftovers.

filledDigests(bytes32).notice: Tracks filled (or cancelled) order digests for replay protection.

openLeverage((uint8,address,address,addr.notice: Fill a signed RFQ order to open a leveraged position.

openLeverageFlash((uint8,address,address.notice: Flash-style open: borrow first, then execute a fill callback that must deliver         `buyToken` to this engine so it can be deposited as collateral for `order.user`.

orderDigest((uint8,address,address,addre.notice: Compute the EIP-712 digest for an order. Useful for off-chain callers.

preSignature(bytes32).notice: PreSign scheme. Flat mapping keyed by keccak256(owner, digest).

setPreSignature(bytes32,bool).notice: Approve an order digest via PreSign (contract-wallet / strategy pattern).

swapCollateral((uint8,address,address,ad.notice: Fill a signed RFQ order to swap collateral for collateral.

swapCollateralFlash((uint8,address,addre.notice: Flash-style collateral swap: withdraw collateral first, then execute a fill callback         that must deliver `buyToken` to this engine so it can be deposited as collateral for `user`.

userdoc.notice: RFQ-style engine for opening leveraged positions without flash loans:         a filler deposits collateral for the user, then the engine borrows         and transfers the borrowed asset to the filler to settle the trade.
